help_description: Here are all the available commands:
help_rotation_field_value:
`/rotation` — View the game rotation with session counts and last played dates.
`/add-game` — Add a game to the rotation.
`/remove-game` — Remove a game from the rotation.
help_session_field_value: `/log-session` — Log a session for a game you played.
